note: Jump share from the London session open to each checkpoint, as a PERCENT of realised variance. A live part-day reading must be scored against the checkpoint it has actually reached, never against a full-day percentile — a part-day share is both noisier and biased high. `periodicity` is the frozen 48-bucket diurnal curve (UTC 30-min buckets, mean 1) the live Lee-Mykland detector divides by; it is never refit live.
